notes.title: Release of our strategy Last Day of Rome!
notes.notes:
Today is a big day. Our biggest game started - Last Day of Rome. It has been a long way. In Early Access, the game occupied 600 megabytes, and now 2200.

For a long time, the Roman Empire subjugates and captures everything in its path. Conceited and greedy for power Romans never met worthy rivals on their way until they got to the lands of the barbarians. The invaders don't tolerate anything except total obedience, taking our fellows into slavery, taking away the lands that we conquered with sweat and blood. That's enough! The time has come to show what we can do! Let's take up arms, brethren, and together we will succeed in crushing the insatiable Roman Empire!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015090/Last_Day_of_Rome/

notes.title: Huge update!
notes.notes:
Huge update!
We collected statistics and your feedback and worked for a long time to fully update the balance of the game and make it more interesting.
At the moment the following has been changed:
- Added top-300 of songs
- Changed the prize for getting into the top. Bottom places bring a little more, the top places began to bring much less.
- Profit from earnings in the clubs has grown substantially.
- The shooting of the clip now also gives significantly more from each of your fans.
- Changed the profit for the work and the salary of the group. - Profit from earnings in the clubs has grown substantially.
- The shooting of the clip now also gives significantly more from each of your fans.
- Changed the profit for the work and the salary of the group. The salary grows now more smoothly, and gradually becomes less arcade.
- The cost of super goals has also been reduced and the progress of the quality of songs has been slightly corrected.

We hope that this update will please you and make the game more varied and interesting. Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: A massive update in Music Band Manager!
notes.notes:
We read your feedback and always try to respond to them. 
The first thing we added in this update is the mechanics of changing backgrounds. Now when you rehearse - the musicians move to the recording studio and rehearse there. Of course, this will add dynamics to the game and somehow revive it. 
The second is another completely new starting background. Now when the group is in the very beginning of the game, you start in the garage. Now when you open a new location, the background changes much more. :) 
The third update is that we added new music to the game. Earlier it was very strange that there is so little music in the music game. Now we have increased the number of tracks by 3 times. :) 
The fourth update is the correction of a number of bugs. Earlier if you play very long and the same things drop, you could wear only one item of one type. 
Finally, we fixed it and you can put as many things of the same type as you want. 
Also we have slightly corrected the French localization and corrected a few errors about which you wrote. 
We hope you will appreciate the new update. And thank you for being with us!)

notes.title: One more update)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
On Friday, we introduced a new update. Finally, we added German, which was promised. For us it was a long and difficult work, but the main thing is that it was written by 80% native speaker.

notes.title: Extensive update!
notes.notes:
Extensive update!
- We have added a new game system - Advertising. Now you can promote your band and get new and new fans.
- And we added another new game system - Music Videos. You can choose the director, location, actors and other aspects for shooting the best clip. Each clip will motivate your fans to talk about your band and increase album sales depending on the number of your fans.
- We changed a lot of windows, now there are more edits in half of the windows. We corrected the layout, so that the texts don't overlap, in other places we created new icons or changed the panels completely. More than 30 edits may not be so noticeable, but together they make the game much prettier and more complete.
- We changed game name. People didnt understand well what is "music awards manager". So we changed it.

Thank you for being with us! We hope for your positive feedback, if you notice how we improved the game over the past month and a half. ;)

notes.title: Tuesday Update
notes.notes:
- Today we updated the Tours, slightly adjusted them up (we changed the speed, so that they don't sweep before your eyes in a second)
- Also at the end of the tutorial we added one more action - the beginning of the rehearsal. Previously, players immediately after the tutorial didn't quite understand what to do, but now it will be more clearer what to do next and also there will be some time to click on the map and sort out the control a little.

We have started work on Advertising and Filming of Clips. Tentatively, we will launch this update in mid-January.
Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! :)

notes.title: Update (Tours already in game!)
notes.notes:
This is a Monday update, and we finally make you happy with the Tours update!
While the update in a more or less first draft and of course will still be fixing it, but we think it will please you even now. :)
Now that you have completed a map, you will be able to give the tour in the last location. On average, you will be able to give one tour once a month.
You select several cities from the previous location and perform there. The number of fans you get  and the profit depends on the day of the game, so if you have written a lot of songs for a while, but performed very few times, then you can quickly catch up with the right number right here.
During the Tour, unusual events may happen to you, which we hope will bring you even more pleasant moments. :)
Next in line are two updates: Advertising and Video Clips. The first one will allow you to convert money into fans, and the second one is gonna be very interesting and will allow you to make music videos for songs and increase album sales. The more fans you have, the more sales you will get from making clips, so that at last the whole money-fan-album-sales cycle will be completed. :)

Thank you for being with us and thank you for your attention to the Music Awards Manager. :)
And if you like our speed of work - write good review - that would be best for us;)

notes.title: Monday fix + update
notes.notes:
Good morning everybody! :)
Today we have an update, which complements that one we released on Friday.
- You can't work and conduct rehearsals or write songs at the same time. So we removed this phantom opportunity.
- Added Turkish language. Thanks 4s*, you did a great work and it was very cool to see that players like the game so much that they spend so much time translating. ;)
- Fixed the maximum quality of the song. Also a little changed the formula for calculating the quality of songs in the top. Now it will be a bit more dynamic. You will rise higher in the top, but you will quickly change your place too. Dynamics is good.
Also tomorrow, we'll rework the window of performances in the club so that you can assign performances at the club for a month ahead or cancel it with only one button. Earlier when you open a new club it was quite long to appoint them. Also we will add a scroll for selecting songs for performances in the club. Convenience is extremely important and we are trying for you. ;)

notes.title: Friday update
notes.notes:
A Friday update is already in the store! :)

- We added the Portuguese language (many thanks to Jean Dias and his friends!). Now we hope that the Brazilians will also be able to evaluate our game in all subtleties, and not only in English. :)
- We put the "Work" in a separate button on the main screen. Some players asked: "Why do I send a musician to work, and the others disappear". Now you will understand that all musicians work. :)
- We added the "Achievements" icon and put it to a prominent place. Super Goals is a very important part of the game. In fact, these are the most important goals that can show that you are going through the game at the steepest and most difficult level, so we want to emphasize their value and importance. Hopefully, such a beautiful button will show it. :)
- We added the "Exit" button to the panel. Now you don't have to press Esc button to bring up the menu. :)
- Also we have slightly improved some buttons (map and others).

Congratulations to everyone on Friday! :) And we hope that you notice our efforts and leave positive feedback :)

notes.title: Balance update (day 400+)
notes.notes:
Today we made an update of the difficulty after 400+ day
Previously, the progress of songs in the top was too fast. We slowed it down, because at the late stage of the game it was unreasonably difficult to get into the top.
After the update, new songs that will appear will be of lower quality. So the old save works, but you will fully feel the update either in 3 months after downloading or if playing from scratch.
But I think 3 months is still much better than playing with such difficulty as it was)

notes.title: Huge update! (TOP200, 8 years, new record studios)
notes.notes:
Today we made a big update. 
No, today we made a super-duper big update! :) By popular demand: 
1. We changed the recording of songs. Now any studio improves the song. The studios began to give a much greater improvement in the song, so that the songs in the top from the opponents will also become stronger. But the most important thing is that now having written down the song, the quality will not fall and when you perform in the club your songs will only be stronger after the recording. 
2. We are remaking the top. Now instead of top-100 in the game will be top-200. It will be better now and you will have a chance to get to the top almost always. If you on the contrary love high complexity you can always play on medium or hard difficulty. Because of this update, old backups will be easier, because immediately after downloading becoming top-101 in the first 3 months will be indecently simple. So, I reccomend you to start again to enjoy the update. 
3. We added 4 more arcade years to the game. Now at the end of the fourth year the game won't end. You will be able to play for 4 more years. These 4 years will be more in "sandbox" mode (without super-goal updates, with poor progress of work, without adding new regions), but nevertheless they will be and if you want you can now play 8 years instead of 4.

All these three things you've been asking many times. And we slept four hours a day to make this update for you. I hope you appreciate our efforts for you and write a positive feedback. :)

notes.title: Release (and last update before release)
notes.notes:
Hi!
I am glad to say that right now there is French in game. There is 200 pages of texts, so that was hard to do)
I fixed all windows that had problems with languages
I fixed about 70% of windows where the text went beyond the borders
And added POP images and animations
In total, all four genres are fully represented (Rock, POP, Hip Hop, Electro)
We are all in touch, monitor all-all errors about which you will write, so that everything can be quickly corrected.
Thank you for following us!)
